```text
--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 6m18s | run 20261112-194018-hunt-0d27 | 5 confirmed, 0 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3791

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. MEDIUM Clicking the Journal nav link while a search is active clears the URL but keeps the search box and filtered results
   where: /journal
   expected: Opening /journal from the nav shows the unfiltered latest entries with an empty search box, matching the URL
   saw: {"url":"/journal","box":"courgette","shown":["Courgette","Courgette","Courgette"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194018-hunt-0d27/probes/journalpage.mjs (expectation "nav-link-state-consistent")
2. MEDIUM Malformed journal list response is rendered as fake entries on the Journal page
   where: /journal (GET /api/journal)
   expected: A non-list response shows an error, not search results
   saw: {"items":4,"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","4 entries match","–","–","–","–","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194018-hunt-0d27/probes/faults2.mjs (expectation "journal-malformed-not-shown-as-results")
3. MEDIUM Malformed journal response on plant detail shows fake entries with Edit/Delete buttons
   where: /plants/:id journal section (GET /api/journal?plant_id=)
   expected: An error saying the journal could not be loaded
   saw: 4
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194018-hunt-0d27/probes/faults2.mjs (expectation "detail-malformed-journal-not-fake-entries")
4. MEDIUM Navigating to Journal while its request hangs leaves the old page shown with no loading indicator
   where: /journal
   expected: The Journal page shows 'Loading entries…' or an error
   saw: {"url":"/journal","headings":["Plants","Courgette","Lettuce","Tomato"],"alerts":["3 plants"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194018-hunt-0d27/probes/hang.mjs (expectation "hang-shows-loading-or-error")
5. LOW    Failed 'Add entry' error stays visible after later successful journal actions
   where: /plants/:id journal section
   expected: The add-entry error clears when the user does something else that succeeds, or at least when the form is cleared
   saw: ["Injected 500"]
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-194018-hunt-0d27/probes/faults2.mjs (expectation "stale-add-error-cleared-after-successful-edit")
--- end of rough-ride hunt ---
```
